R388.note: Stored extension now comes from file-type's detected.ext instead of originalname; the returned id changing to the content-derived extension is stated and blocks no legitimate upload.

R389.note: Rejects CR/LF/NUL in every value serialized onto the SMTP wire at the single sink; a multi-line subject or null address was never a well-formed SMTP value, and the rejection is stated.

R390.note: Parameterization is correct, but the explicit SqlDbType.NVarChar size of 256 makes SqlClient silently truncate longer actor values before comparison, a length bound the original did not have.

R391.note: UUID name plus extension mapped from detected MIME closes both traversal and extension spoofing; dropping SVG is stated and is moot in practice because file-type does not detect XML-based SVG, so no previously accepted upload is newly rejected.

R392.note: IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync before QueueAsync is the right shape for a JSON-bound minimal API endpoint; the added authorized token-issuing GET and the 400 on missing token are stated and preserve the contract.

R393.note: PNG/JPEG signature check gates both acceptance and the stored extension; buffering via getBytes and Files.write with CREATE/TRUNCATE_EXISTING is behaviourally equivalent to the original copy.

R394.note: Secure: true closes the finding; HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax are stated hardening that blocks no legitimate use of a server-read session cookie.

R395.note: Build fails: SimpleEvaluationContext has no setRootObject (root object must go through the builder's withRootObject or getValue(context, root)); the intended read-only data-binding context matches the contract, but as written the service does not compile.

R396.note: session.clear() before login_user discards the pre-auth session and the cart id is re-written afterwards; loss of any other guest session keys is stated as the intended discard and a legitimate login still merges the cart.

R397.note: allowed_classes limited to ShoppingCart keeps the cookie wire format and the existing instanceof fallback while stopping gadget-class instantiation.

R398.note: Bound :term with wildcards appended in PHP preserves the %term% substring semantics while keeping the value out of the SQL text.

R399.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) replaces the attacker-seeded System.Random; removing the seed query parameter is stated and callers still get the same {token} shape.

R400.note: Explicit noent:false, dtdload:false, nonet:true is the idiomatic libxmljs lockdown and leaves normal documents parsing unchanged; note the explanation overstates nonet (it blocks http/ftp, not file://) and libxml2 2.9+ already skips external parameter entities without those flags.
